Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Survey of Sexual Victimization, 2016
Authors: Laura M. Maruschak and Emily D. Buehler, Ph.D., BJS Statisticians
Table 6. Sexual victimization reported by federal and state prison authorities, by type of victimization, 2016
Note: Excludes the District of Columbia. See Terms and definitions for information on types of victimization.
a/Excludes inmates in privately operated facilities and facilities operated and administered by local governments. Counts were based on the 2016 National Prisoner Statistics data collection.
b/Allegations of nonconsensual sexual acts were not recorded.
c/Allegations of abusive sexual contact could not be counted separately from allegations of nonconsensual sexual acts.
d/Allegations of staff sexual harassment could not be counted separately from allegations of staff sexual misconduct.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Survey of Sexual Victimization, 2016.
